Radial axes for circular tracks

Source: R/geom-track-axis.R
geom_track_axis.Rd

Draws the two edges of a track band as rings, a radial tick at every node boundary for each break, and the break labels outside the band. The scale is always explicit: limits is required, so the axis can never disagree with how the track layer scaled its data.

Usage

geom_track_axis(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  band,
  limits,
  breaks = NULL,
  labels = ggplot2::waiver(),
  text.size = 3,
  line.size = 0.2,
  tick.length = 0.02,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = FALSE
)

Arguments

mapping, data, stat, position, show.legend, inherit.aes, na.rm, ...

Standard ggplot2::layer() arguments.

band

Track name or c(r0, r1) radius interval.

limits

Value range of the track; required.

breaks

Break positions. NULL uses pretty(limits, 4).

labels

Break labels; waiver() formats them with the default formatter.

text.size

Size of the break labels.

line.size

Width of the rings and ticks.

tick.length

Extra radius reserved for the labels.

Value

A ggplot2 layer.

Examples

set.seed(1)
vals <- data.frame(
    id = rep(colnames(mtcars), each = 4),
    value = runif(ncol(mtcars) * 4),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
ggcircos(cor(mtcars), order = "hclust", tracks = c(values = 0.2)) +
    geom_track(data = vals, aes(x = value), node = id, band = "values") +
    geom_track_axis(band = "values", limits = c(0, 1))
